paragraphs.text: The PlayStation Superdrop is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on October 27, 2025.

The Superdrop contains seven Universes Beyond drops , each a collaboration with a PlayStation game franchise. Each drop contains one or two mechanically unique cards, with the rest being reprints (some being reskinned ). Despite having been officially retired beginning with Marvel's Spider-Man , all cards in this drop retain the Universes Beyond card frame .

The set introduces a variant of Partner . They are formated as Partner—[designator] and work essentially like " friends forever " as they only work as partners if their designator matches. The two designators introduced are "Survivors" and "Father & son".

Buyers received one rainbow foil Sol Ring with each $199 spent on Superdrop products while supplies lasted. The card depicts Sweet Tooth 's vehicle from the Twisted Metal video game, and quotes the character while referencing Calypso .
Non-foil versions of these drops became available for purchase in WPN game stores on December 18, 2025.
As an extra, the drops come with a surprise bonus card. These are all fixed cards.
